title: Global synchronization in time-varying directed higher-order networks
summary: Global synchronization has been largely investigated in static higher-order networks and little attention has been brought to directed, temporal higher-order networks. We hereby make a step in this direction by studying the emergence of global synchronization in periodically fast switching systems with directed higher-order interactions.
